overview.description: The ProShares Ultra XRP ETF (UXRP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long xrp, short usd currency. The fund seeks 2x the daily performance of XRP through futures and swaps. The fund offers amplified exposure to XRP suited for short-term strategies with elevated risk and volatility. UXRP was launched on Jul 14, 2025 and is issued by ProShares.
